SELECT HOUR(t.created_at) AS hour, SUM( CASE t.task_type WHEN '빠른 업무' THEN 5 WHEN '상담 업무' THEN 10 WHEN '기업 • 특수' THEN 25 ELSE 5 END ) / NULLIF(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(t2.created_at)) FROM bank.task t2 WHERE t2.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 WEEK) AND DATE(t2.created_at) < CURDATE() AND DAYOFWEEK(t2.created_at) = DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) AND HOUR(t2.created_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 17 ), 0) AS avgWorkloadMinutes FROM bank.task t WHERE t.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 WEEK) AND DATE(t.created_at) < CURDATE() AND DAYOFWEEK(t.created_at) = DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) AND HOUR(t.created_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 17 GROUP BY HOUR(t.created_at) ORDER BY hour

mapper.select: WITH counters AS ( SELECT 1 AS counterNumber UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 ), working AS ( SELECT DISTINCT counter_number FROM bank.member WHERE status = 1 AND counter_number BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ), calls AS ( SELECT task_id, member_id, MAX(log_id) AS callId FROM bank.task_processing_log WHERE action_type IN ('CALL', 'RECALL') AND created_at >= CURDATE() GROUP BY task_id, member_id ), active AS ( SELECT m.counter_number, t.ticket_number, t.status, calls.callId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.counter_number ORDER BY COALESCE(calls.callId, 0) DESC, t.updated_at DESC, t.task_id DESC) AS position FROM bank.member m JOIN bank.task t ON t.member_id = m.id AND t.status IN ('CALLED', 'IN_PROGRESS') LEFT JOIN calls ON calls.task_id = t.task_id AND calls.member_id = m.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.counter_number BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ) SELECT c.counterNumber, COALESCE(active.ticket_number, '') AS ticketNumber, COALESCE(active.status, CASE WHEN working.counter_number IS NULL THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE 'WAITING' END) AS status, COALESCE(active.callId, 0) AS callId FROM counters c LEFT JOIN working ON working.counter_number = c.counterNumber LEFT JOIN active ON active.counter_number = c.counterNumber AND active.position = 1 ORDER BY c.counterNumber

SELECT `t1`.`task_id` AS `taskId`, `t1`.`user_id` AS `userId`, `t1`.`ticket_number` AS `ticketNumber`, `t1`.`task_type` AS `taskType`, `t1`.`task_detail_type` AS `taskDetailType`, `t1`.`predicted_task_detail_type` AS `predictedTaskDetailType`, `t1`.`confirmed_task_detail_type` AS `confirmedTaskDetailType`, `t1`.`transfer_count` AS `transferCount`, (t1.priority_transferred_at IS NOT NULL) AS priorityTransfer, `t1`.`assigned_level` AS `assignedLevel`, , `t1`.`status` AS `status`, `t1`.`member_id` AS `memberId`,
`t1`.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, `t1`.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt`, `t2`.`name` AS `name`, `t2`.`level` AS `level` FROM `bank`.`task` AS `t1` LEFT JOIN `bank`.`member` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`member_id` = `t2`.`id` WHERE `t1`.`task_id` = #{taskId} ORDER BY `createdAt` DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM `bank`.`task` WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

SELECT t.assigned_level AS taskLevel, COUNT(t.task_id) AS taskCount FROM `bank`.`task` t WHERE DATE(t.created_at) = CURDATE() AND t.status IN ('COMPLETED') GROUP BY t.assigned_level ORDER BY t.assigned_level ASC

SELECT m.id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, m.level AS memberLevel,
-- 1. 업무 상태 로직 (IN_PROGRESS인 태스크가 있으면 '업무중', 없으면 '대기중') CASE WHEN t.status = 'CALLED' THEN '호출중' WHEN t.task_id IS NULL THEN '대기중' ELSE '업무중' END AS currentTaskStatus,
-- 2. 업무 수락 시점 고정 (IN_PROGRESS 상태일 때의 updated_at을 사용) -- 업무 종료(status 변경) 시 t.task_id가 NULL이 되어 시간도 자연스럽게 사라짐 CASE WHEN t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN t.updated_at END AS taskStartedAt, t.expected_waiting_time AS `expectedWaitingTime`, -- 3. 나머지 필요한 데이터들 m.level AS memberRank, -- 필요시 CASE 문으로 '사원', '대리' 변환 가능 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bank`.`task` WHERE member_id = m.id AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(updated_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayCompletedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bank`.`task` WHERE status = 'WAITING') AS waitingCount, t.ticket_number AS currentTicket, t.user_id AS userId, t.task_type AS taskType FROM `bank`.`member` m -- 핵심: 현재 해당 직원이 '진행 중'인 업무만 조인 LEFT JOIN `bank`.`task` t ON m.id = t.member_id AND t.status IN ('CALLED', 'IN_PROGRESS') WHERE m.status = 1 -- 출근한 직원만 조회 ORDER BY m.level DESC, m.name ASC

SELECT -- 오늘 생성되었고 현재 대기 중인 업무 COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'WAITING' AND created_at >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS totalWaiting, -- 오늘 완료 처리된 업무 COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' AND updated_at >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS totalCompleted FROM `bank`.`task` WHERE (status = 'WAITING' AND created_at >= CURDATE()) OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND updated_at >= CURDATE())

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.ticket_number AS ticketNumber, u.name AS userName, t.task_type AS taskType, t.task_detail_type AS taskDetailType, m.id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, m.counter_number AS counterNumber, -- member 테이블에 창구번호 컬럼이 있다고 가정 t.status AS status FROM `bank`.`task` t LEFT JOIN `bank`.`user` u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `bank`.`member` m ON t.member_id = m.id WHERE t.status IN ('WAITING') ORDER BY t.created_at ASC

SELECT `t1`.`log_id` AS `logId`, `t1`.`task_id` AS `taskId`, `t1`.`member_id` AS `memberId`, `t1`.`action_type` AS `actionType`, `t1`.`processing_note` AS `processingNote`, `t1`.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, `t3`.`id` AS `userId` FROM `bank`.`task_processing_log` AS `t1` LEFT JOIN `bank`.`task` AS `t2` on t1.task_id = t2.task_id LEFT JOIN `bank`.`user` AS `t3` on t2.user_id = t3.id WHERE t3.id = #{userId} ORDER BY t1.created_at DESC
